status: implemented, qualified and committed; original goal active
motivation: The inward public regression exposed approximation consumed inside interval multiplication used for certified outer bounds. Chord-pair bounds now locally suppress terminals; the private interval arithmetic API itself still accepts the geometry predicate context.
candidate: Remove CurveContext from purely conservative Real interval arithmetic and migrate callers directly. Exact enclosure decisions must never use a terminal approximate scalar equality.
source_audit: This implementation owns only lower/upper Real values. Its context is used for scalar sign/order and passed among arithmetic/evaluation helpers. It does not own a geometry replay policy, root selection or point construction. Geometry callers still need their own contexts.
constraints: Preserve arbitrary exact Real endpoint payloads; rational enclosure conversion remains optional and must keep requested refinement.
Keep geometry policy validation, selected-root/sheet decisions and explicit work budgets in their owning layers. Do not replace original contexts wholesale in callers.
Investigate cheap conservative fallback for undecided scalar signs and value ordering. Removing approximate decisions must not accidentally force unbounded reconstruction in optional bounds.
Update all controlled callers without forwarding aliases. Type checking can identify the correct overloaded interval-method calls; do not globally rewrite unrelated multiply/divide methods.
Add focused exact-enclosure regressions for near-zero and conditioned supports where useful; retain public inward closure and the existing >512-bit refinement tests.
Audit other certified bound producers and their cache semantics after the arithmetic migration; the current targeted repair does not prove all producers sound.

baseline.finding: Multiplying [-2*epsilon,epsilon] by [-1,1] consumes Approximate512, where epsilon=1-cos(2^-607). An optional enclosure must not consume a topology terminal.
baseline.coverage: Five operations (multiply, square, square root, value hull, divide), both contexts, independently known contained witnesses whenever an optional enclosure is returned.

migration.ownership: Geometry policy validation, selected-root and denominator/sheet decisions, and bounded-pass guards remain in existing callers. Only conservative arithmetic selects strict scalar predicates internally.

other_interval_types_audited: Hypersolve has theorem-specific rational interval kernels and an AlgebraicPolynomialValueInterval report carrier. They are not blindly substituted for this general exact-Real arithmetic; their rational reconstruction guards remain intact.
